scope: Bounded actual-engine regressions for experimental analog extensions. No arbitrary-layout equivalence, foundry calibration, or fabrication signoff.

sky130_devices.scope: Listed bounded geometry and deterministic PVT probes only; no arbitrary-layout or foundry signoff.

sky130_bipolar.scope: Fixed SKY130 PNP W3.40/L3.40, listed multiplicities and emitter-size fault only; no NPN or arbitrary bipolar qualification.

extraction_update.change: PNP device selection uses upstream emitter-area rules; DRC and other extraction rules unchanged.
extraction_update.scope: Fixed PNP W3.40/L3.40 coupons only; every edited design needs DRC/LVS.

islands.criterion: Resistor-only connected component with no port, device terminal or capacitor endpoint. All observable circuit lines retained verbatim.

fill_coupling.scope: No direct core/fill interaction within this finite-range open-PDK model. Does not quantify longer-range fields, fill-to-fill networks or foundry-calibrated parasitics.

device_parameters.junction_scope: Pre-R area/perimeter fields retained when splitting shared nets changes Magic redistribution; unambiguous model/terminals/all other parameters required.
device_parameters.scope: All physical model/value/parameter fields after contracting only distributed wire resistance.

export.resistor_graph: exact original named edge multiset preserved

resistor_values.final_values: Original .res.ext resistance scaled to ohms at 17 significant digits.

export.physical_device_lines: preserved except explicitly reported pre-R junction area/perimeter restoration
export.non_capacitor_lines: preserved except original full-precision distributed resistance values restored
export.quantization_reason: Supported Magic esSIvalue emits C below 1 aF as zero; all parasitic C is serialized at 17 significant digits.

gf180_rc.scope: Extraction and fill controls only; post-RC PVT/startup has not been qualified.

reproduction.sky130: python scripts/qualify_sky130_devices.py --pdk PDK_ADAPTER --out FRESH_OUTPUT --magic MAGIC_8_3_600 --netgen NETGEN_1_5_300 --ngspice NGSPICE
reproduction.gf180_extraction: python scripts/qualify_gf180_rc.py --open-pdks OPEN_PDKS --out FRESH_OUTPUT --magic LOCKED_PATCHED_MAGIC --ngspice NGSPICE_KLU --extraction-only
reproduction.sky130_bipolar: python scripts/qualify_sky130_bipolar.py --pdk BIPOLAR_PDK_ADAPTER --out FRESH_OUTPUT --magic MAGIC_8_3_600 --netgen NETGEN_1_5_300
reproduction.gf180_full: python scripts/qualify_gf180_rc.py --open-pdks OPEN_PDKS --out FRESH_OUTPUT --magic LOCKED_PATCHED_MAGIC --ngspice NGSPICE_KLU
reproduction.qualification_runtime: Dependencies were staged inside the workspace. Magic/Netgen were built from exact source locks. ngspice used the Ubuntu package, with initializer paths relocated; a local tmpfile/ tmpfile64 shim redirected only temporary files into writable TMPDIR because libc tmpfile ignores TMPDIR. No model, solver, circuit, measurement, or acceptance result was altered by the shim.

simulation.scope: Distributed R and conserved original C; isolated unobservable R-only components omitted with proof.

gf180-rc-pvt-nominal.scope: Pinned reference and bounded open-PDK parasitic model; no foundry calibration or signoff.

gf180-rc-pvt-final.scope: Final implementation post-RC operating points and startup ramps for nominal process at125C,2.7V, plus27C3.3V nominal operating point. Other process corners and supply/temperature cases are not qualified on this final extracted deck. No foundry signoff.

simulation.scope: Distributed R and conserved original C; isolated unobservable R-only components omitted with proof.

remaining_snapshot.scope: Completed rows from an in-progress four-corner qualification; missing rows are not qualified. These rows use the earlier extracted electrical deck, not the final parameter-audited extraction.
